dedupeText: high contrast collage with masked portraits silhouette masking halftone 90s aesthetic high contrast duotone collage large numeral 7 acting as a window for photographic portraits silhouette figure with solarized orange edges contrasting against deep black shadows cool blue photographic tones within the numeral contrasting with warm orange glows in the silhouette handwritten script overlapping the lower third of the composition combine a high contrast silhouette with an inner glow effect and a large geometric clipping mask containing monochromatic imagery to create a layered 90s inspired graphic composition

recipe.visualDefinition: A graphic composition featuring a large, high-contrast silhouette of a figure with a glowing orange aura, overlaid by a large, stylized numeral mask containing blue-toned portraits. The design is set against a clean white background with secondary handwritten-style typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Large numeral '7' acting as a window for photographic portraits
Silhouette figure with solarized orange edges contrasting against deep black shadows
Cool blue photographic tones within the numeral contrasting with warm orange glows in the silhouette
Handwritten script overlapping the lower third of the composition
coreInvariants: High-contrast black silhouette with orange 'inner glow' or solarization effect
Numeral-shaped clipping mask for blue-tinted imagery
Stark white negative space in the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large silhouette occupies the left and center; a massive numeral '7' dominates the right half and center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large numeral '7' serves as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the top bar of the '7' to the right, descends the diagonal stem, and settles on the handwritten text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space on the right and top-left provides breathing room for the dense central graphics.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white background and black silhouette; high saturation in the orange glow edges.

letterConstructionRules: Top text follows the horizontal bar of the numeral with wide tracking
Bottom text is a casual, slanted brush script with variable line weight
The numeral '7' is a custom geometric shape with sharp angles
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a', 'f', 't', 'e', 'r' are spaced widely and placed inside the top of the numeral
The '7' features a slight curve at the bottom of the stem
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Geometric block numeral paired with organic, expressive brush script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the casual, slanted, hand-written feel of the secondary text.
Approximates the serif style used for the text inside the numeral.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a high-contrast silhouette of a person against a white background. Apply a vibrant orange solarization or inner glow effect to the edges of the silhouette. Create a large geometric numeral '7' and use it as a mask for a blue-tinted, halftone-textured collage of male faces.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place lowercase serif text inside the top bar of the '7' with wide tracking. Add a slanted, orange-red brush script phrase across the bottom third, overlapping both the silhouette and the numeral.

verificationChecks: Is the orange glow confined to the silhouette edges?
Does the numeral '7' contain blue-toned portraits?
Does the script text overlap the main graphic elements?

adjustableVariables: Tint of the portraits inside the mask
Specific numeral used for the mask
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the portraits

mustAchieve: Balanced use of warm and cool accents

postGenerationChecks: Check for sharp edges on the numeral mask
Ensure the orange glow doesn't bleed into the white background
Verify the blue tint is consistent across all portraits in the mask
Confirm the script text is legible despite the overlap
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast silhouette with an 'inner glow' effect and a large geometric clipping mask containing monochromatic imagery to create a layered, 90s-inspired graphic composition.
